defs.def: an object shaped like a ball with a map of the world on its surface, usually on a stand so that it can be turned 地球仪
the world (used especially to emphasize its size) 地球，世界（尤用以强调其大）

ex.s: Located to the south of the equator, below many other countries on the globe, it’s often informally referred to as “down under”.
ex.t: 它位于赤道以南，在地球上许多其他国家的下方，因此常被非正式地称为“down under”。

ex.s: According to the World Bank, China accounts for about 30 percent of total   67   (globe) fertilizer consumption.
ex.t: 根据世界银行，中国约占全球____67____（globe）化肥消费总量的30%。

ex.s: Young children across the globe enjoy playing games of hide and seek.
ex.t: 对他们来说，_21_别人的目光并让自己不被看见是一件非常刺激的事情。

ex.s: In the coming months, we are bringing together artists form all over the globe, to enjoy speaking Shakespeare’s plays in their own language, in our Globe, within the architecture Shakespeare wrote for.
ex.t: 在接下来的几个月里，我们将汇聚来自全球各地的艺术家，在我们的环球剧场、在莎士比亚当年写作时所设计的建筑中，用他们各自的语言来演绎莎士比亚的戏剧。

ex.s: The D-Day Landings By spring 1944, the Second World War had been raging across the globe for about five years.
ex.t: 诺曼底登陆：到1944年春天，第二次世界大战已经在全球范围内激烈进行了大约五年。

ex.s: The fundamental purpose of Silkroad is to bring people from across the globe together to play and listen to music.
ex.t: 丝绸之路的基本目的是将全球各地的人们聚集在一起演奏和聆听音乐。

ex.s: DIVING DEEP Lying under waters across the globe are an estimated three million shipwrecks.
ex.t: 深潜 据估计，全球水域之下沉睡着约 300 万艘沉船。

ex.s: Countries around the globe are spending billions of dollars and lots of time on various space missions, whether to Mars or other planets much further away.
ex.t: 全球各国正在花费数十亿美元和大量时间进行各种太空任务，无论是前往火星还是其他更远的行星。

ex.s: Like many young people, Jessica wants to travel the globe.
ex.t: 像许多年轻人一样，Jessica想去环游世界。
